shared_elements: incised/carved marks on a prepared stone surface
a bounded rectangular or panel-like field of decoration
justification: Both show a stone surface bearing carved marks confined to a defined panel, but A is filled with regular horizontal lines of small linear script-like signs with no pictorial content, while B shows a single large curvilinear composite creature-mask with bold interlocking relief scrolls, eyes and jaw. There is no correspondence in the specific motifs, in relationships between elements, or in the manner of rendering (fine incised lines versus deep rounded relief).
